excerpt: Standard AI (formerly Standard Cognition) began with cashierless checkout and now sells VISION, camera-based shopper analytics for physical retail.
content:
Standard AI is a computer vision company for physical retail. It started out as Standard Cognition, building autonomous checkout: ceiling-mounted cameras tracked which products a shopper picked up so they could walk out without queuing, without using facial recognition. In February 2021 it raised a $150 million Series C led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, with CRV, EQT Ventures, TI Platform Management and SK Networks, which Retail Dive reported valued it at $1 billion. At the time it said it planned to fit out more than 50,000 checkout-free stores over five years.

The company has since moved from checkout to analytics. Its current product, VISION, uses a store's existing security cameras to measure what shoppers see and do. Standard AI builds a digital twin of the store, runs its models on edge hardware in the store so video stays local, and sends only anonymised data to the cloud. Retailers use it to measure in-store media and promotions ('verified impressions'), see how shoppers and staff move through the store, and judge which areas and fixtures work. At NRF 2025 the company presented VISION as a way to give retailers real-time insight into promotion performance.

Standard AI does not publish prices; it sells to retailers and consumer brands after a demo and a site assessment. We could not find independent reporting on its revenue or any funding after 2021.

It is relevant to grocery, convenience and specialty retailers that want store analytics comparable to what e-commerce sites get from web analytics, and to brands that pay for in-store media and want proof it works.

This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting, checked on 15 October 2026. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.

faq.q: Is Standard AI the same as Standard Cognition?
faq.a: Yes. Standard Cognition is the company's former name.

faq.q: Does Standard AI still do cashierless checkout?
faq.a: Its current site focuses on VISION store analytics rather than autonomous checkout.

faq.q: How much funding did Standard raise?
faq.a: Its largest reported round was a $150 million Series C in February 2021 led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2.
No. Reporting on its system and the company's own site describe anonymised, privacy-safe tracking.
